method: Direct inspection of every planned Poppler page PNG and both detail crops. Page renders use 96 dpi; details use 144 dpi. A selection-caption metadata correction for 015 was followed by a deterministic rerender; every resulting PNG hash equals the already-inspected image hash.

pages.name: index-1
pages.observation: Clear heading, totals, legend and two-column photo list; no overlap with provenance/footer. Early-series entries and destinations remain legible.

pages.name: index-2
pages.observation: Both columns, counts, photo names and page references are clear and separated from footer text.

pages.name: index-3
pages.observation: Late-series names, stars, counts and page references remain clear; no clipped entries or footer overlap.

pages.name: index-4
pages.observation: The last new-series entries and all 31 old-series entries are included with clear spacing and complete page references through 145.

pages.name: new_000001
pages.observation: All 51 current fronts are visible; amended row 22 uses magenta for its box and tag, while unchanged points retain cyan. Footer and photograph fit the page.

pages.name: new_000094
pages.observation: All 38 current fronts are shown. Row 23 is the single amended box; the saved ymin 605 change is visible, with ymax retained. Row 30 remains available as a nearby reference.

pages.name: new_000096
pages.reason: rack edits and two removed right points
pages.observation: All 46 current fronts are visible. Box and point colours distinguish their actual changed fields. Rows 37/38 retain cyan boxes with starred magenta tags for removed right points; neither deleted point is drawn. Footer records both removed fields and the current missing-point ranges.

pages.name: new_000100
pages.observation: All 56 fronts and the 15 amended boxes on rows 34-48 are shown. Unchanged corner markers remain cyan. Dense rows, tags and footer ranges are readable.

pages.name: new_000015
pages.observation: All 61 current fronts are shown, including 7 amended box rows 10-12,31,38,43,46. Occluded-front row tags and missing-point lists remain readable; this page is not described as unchanged.

pages.name: old_000003
pages.observation: First old-series page includes all 10 saved fronts and their current points, using cyan for unchanged fields. Original perspective, framing and image orientation are preserved.

pages.name: old_000101
pages.observation: Last old-series page includes all 8 saved fronts and current points with clear tags and footer; the final page is complete.

pages.name: new_000019
pages.observation: The densest page includes all 63 current row tags. Visible tag offsets avoid overlap; the 24 amended rows are distinguishable, including the small lower partial fronts. No clipping or unreadable footer was observed.

detail_crops.observation: The enlarged PDF crop shows row 23 top edge at saved ymin 605, aligned near row 30 top at 609. Row 23 bottom remains at 655.990002. No point or neighboring-row geometry is shifted by the renderer.

The enlarged PDF crop shows the left circles on rows 37/38 and no right marker for either row. The nearby cyan square belongs to row 36 and is retained correctly; canonical missing coordinates produce no replacement marker.

packaging_changes: Infer repository root from script location.
Require explicit PDF and report paths.
Correct the representative-selection purpose for015 to current saved-label inventory; no assertion changed.
Require explicit vector-report and raster-output paths.

evidence_policy: The reviewed PDF and full raster PNGs are external artifacts, identified by filename and SHA256. They are not committed to Git. Page numbers, DPI, detail crop regions, observations and reproducer scripts are retained here; no scratch directory is required.
limits: Visual inspection covers these 12 representative/index pages and 2 detail crops. All 141 photograph pages were checked independently at the PDF object/vector level. This verifies faithful rendering of the approved saved labels and does not constitute a new pixel-level annotation review of every object.
